title: Genome accessibility reveals disease risk that gene expression misses
title_zh: 基因组可及性揭示基因表达忽略的疾病风险
abstract: The effects of disease-associated genetic variants on gene expression and genome accessibility have been analysed together.
abstract_zh: 已对疾病相关基因变异对基因表达和基因组可及性的影响进行联合分析。
